---
title: "Types and values"
---

## Data types

Data types are written as py-polars names: `'Int8'` … `'Int64'`, `'UInt8'` … `'UInt64'`, `'Float32'`, `'Float64'`, `'Boolean'`, `'String'`, `'Binary'`, `'Date'`, `'Datetime'` (microseconds), `'Datetime(ms, UTC)'`, `'Duration(us)'`, `'Time'`, `'Categorical'`, `'Null'`, `'Decimal(10, 2)'`, and `'List(Int64)'`. `Phpolars\DataType` has the same names as constants (`DataType::Int64`), and `DataType::datetime('ms', 'UTC')` builds the parameterized names.

## Values

{{< include ../examples/_values.md >}}

| Polars | PHP |
| --- | --- |
| integer types | `int` (UInt64 values beyond `PHP_INT_MAX` become `float`) |
| Float32, Float64 | `float` |
| Boolean | `bool` |
| String, Categorical | `string` |
| Date, Datetime | `DateTimeImmutable` (naive values in UTC, zoned values in their zone) |
| Time | `string`, `"HH:MM:SS.ffffff"` |
| Duration | `int` in the column's time unit |
| Decimal | `string` |
| List, Array | list |
| Struct | associative array |

From PHP, each column gets one inferred type. Integers widen to floats, nulls fit any type, `DateTimeInterface` values become `Datetime(us)` on their wall-clock time, lists become `List`, and associative arrays become `Struct`. Any other mix raises `SchemaError`; pass a `schema` to set types.

## Errors

Polars errors are thrown as subclasses of `Phpolars\PolarsError`, named after the py-polars exceptions: `ColumnNotFoundError`, `ComputeError`, `DuplicateError`, `InvalidOperationError`, `NoDataError`, `OutOfBoundsError`, `SchemaError`, `SchemaFieldNotFoundError`, `ShapeError`, and `StructFieldNotFoundError`, all in `Phpolars\Exception`. Invalid arguments raise PHP's `ValueError`.
